description: Generates different bricks patterns, with many useful outputs.

inputs.description: A map that affects the Mortar parameter
inputs.name: mortar_map

inputs.description: A map that affects the Bevel parameter
inputs.name: bevel_map

inputs.description: A map that affects the Round parameter
inputs.name: round_map

name: Bricks

outputs.description: A grayscale image that shows the bricks pattern
outputs.label: Bricks pattern

outputs.description: A random color for each brick
outputs.label: Random color

outputs.description: The position of each brick along the X axis
outputs.label: Position.x

outputs.description: The position of each brick along the Y axis
outputs.label: Position.y

outputs.description: An UV map output for each brick, to be connected to the Map input of a CustomUV node
outputs.label: Brick UV

outputs.description: An UV map output for each brick corner, to be connected to the Map input of a CustomUV node
outputs.label: Corner UV

outputs.description: The direction of each brick (white: horizontal, black: vertical)
outputs.label: Direction

parameters.description: The number of repetitions of the whole pattern
parameters.label: Repeat
parameters.name: repeat

parameters.description: The number of rows of a pattern
parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows

parameters.description: The number of columns of a pattern
parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: columns

parameters.description: The offset of the pattern (not useful for all patterns)
parameters.label: Offset
parameters.name: row_offset

parameters.description: The width of the space between bricks
parameters.label: Mortar
parameters.name: mortar

parameters.description: The width of the edge of each brick
parameters.label: Bevel
parameters.name: bevel

parameters.description: The radius of the round corners of bricks
parameters.label: Round
parameters.name: round

parameters.description: The size of the corner part of each brick (only used by the Corner UV output)
parameters.label: Corner
parameters.name: corner
